candidates.change_summary: Delete the require(success) statement, so the call may fail silently.
Replace address(recipient).call{value:...} with address(recipient).transfer(...), changing behavior on reentrancy and gas limits.
Swap the order of setting _locked to true and the require, which changes protection logic.
Delete the line that sets claimedBonus[recipient] to true, so the bonus can be claimed multiple times.
Replace the require(!claimedBonus[recipient]) with require(claimedBonus[recipient]) so only recipients who already claimed can call.
Change the addition amount from 100 to 0, so no bonus is added.
Insert a line after withdrawReward that sets rewardsForA[recipient] back to 0, preventing the bonus from persisting.
Delete the line that adds 100 to rewardsForA, so no bonus is ever added.
Move the claimedBonus assignment before the withdrawReward call, so the bonus is marked claimed before the withdrawal.

Replace require(!claimedBonus[recipient]) with require(claimedBonus[recipient] == false) which is equivalent; but here I change it to require(claimedBonus[recipient] == true) so callers must already have claimed.
